title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change, as Modified by Amendment No. 1, To List and Trade Shares of the Valkyrie XBTO Bitcoin Futures Fund Under Nasdaq Rule 5711(g)
summary: On 9 September 2021, the Federal Register published an SEC notice that Nasdaq had filed a proposed rule change (File No. SR-NASDAQ-2021-066), as modified by Amendment No. 1, to list and trade shares of the Valkyrie XBTO Bitcoin Futures Fund under Nasdaq Rule 5711(g), Nasdaq's listing standard for trusts holding futures contracts rather than the underlying commodity. Valkyrie Funds LLC, the fund's sponsor and commodity pool operator, states the trust would invest primarily in cash-settled bitcoin futures traded on the Chicago Mercantile Exchange, plus cash and money market instruments, tracking bitcoin's performance less expenses. Nasdaq filed the original proposal on 23 August 2021 and Amendment No. 1 on 25 August 2021. Publication opened a public comment period under Exchange Act Section 19(b)(1); the notice does not resolve how the SEC will act.
why_it_matters: This is the same procedural first step -- publishing an exchange's proposal and opening it to public comment -- that the SEC requires before approving, disapproving, or opening formal proceedings on any crypto exchange-traded product; here the underlying product held bitcoin futures rather than bitcoin itself. The notice does not resolve, and does not address, how the SEC ultimately acted on the proposal.
